formula: segment k minutes = base[k] * dayFactors[day type][hour] * partFactors[weekday|weekend][part[k]][hour]; a live bus reported at stop i has already spent elapsed[i] times the same factors; routes with use=false keep the timetable
timeKeys: day type of the service day (00:00-03:59 counts as the previous day): Mon-Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; weekend = Sat and Sun; hour = local clock hour when the bus reaches the segment
